ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 92% low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels to 8% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark-intensity base. High-contrast white focal points (circular rosettes) are scattered across both lobes. A distinct concentration of high-intensity linear pixel streaks is mapped on the mid-to-outer portion of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central depression with a measured angular aperture of approximately 65 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency sawtooth-like pixel transitions. Prominent notches are visible on the inner-right lobe trailing edge and smaller serrations along the left lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature following a symmetric parabolic path from the median notch to the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple discrete, small (5-15 pixel diameter) circular white pixel clusters across both lobe surfaces, representing localized pigment loss or old attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several vertical and diagonal high-intensity white linear sequences (rake marks) concentrated on the ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, textured, heterogeneous high-contrast clusters (white and brownish pixel groups) indicating significant biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
